## Activity

North City Eye Clinic completed 39 captures during August 2022. This activity provides the basis for the review of image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The recorded volume represents the total number of captures submitted by the site during the reporting period.

The activity record also indicates that staff raised no new equipment faults this month. No additional operational issue is identified in the available report information.

## Image quality

Of the 39 captures, 1 was ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.6 per cent. This result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity when reviewing the quality of images submitted by the clinic.

The report records the ungradable result without identifying any further equipment-related cause. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

A total of 7 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 11 days. These figures summarise the grading outcome and the time taken for results to be graded during August 2022.

Together, the activity, image quality and grading figures provide the monthly operational position for North City Eye Clinic.
